source.surface: version history table with a revert confirmation open over it, unsaved-change warning stated
source.attribution: Screen curated by Mobbin (https://mobbin.com). Inspected remotely through the Mobbin MCP under accessMode 'remote-mcp'. No image was downloaded, cached, embedded, or stored anywhere in this repository; every value below is our own reading of the rendered screen.

evidenceTier.rationale: Mobbin is a curated gallery of captured screens. It is not a live observation we made of a running product, and no audience outcome is attached, so it cannot be silver/M2 or gold/M3. Treat these facts as evidence that a shipped product once looked this way, not as evidence that it worked.

decisionColour.acceptControlTreatment: solid red fill with a white label
decisionColour.rejectControlTreatment: Cancel, unfilled label text to its right
decisionColour.undecidedContainerTreatment: the dialog body and the pre-filled comment field are plain white with a neutral border; no red tint on the field or the body
decisionColour.verdict: Decision colour on the button only, but the ordering is inverted relative to Navattic: here the committing red button sits LEFT of Cancel, so the destructive control occupies the position the eye reaches first.
